subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: Should bundled Telegram support include Telegram Business personal-DM handling now, and what account-scoped `business_connection_id` authority model should it use?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but Telegram Business connects OpenClaw to personal DMs and lets it reply through Business account authority after the prior implementation was closed pending Telegram-owner direction.

options.title: Approve bounded bundled support
options.body: Implement this in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Require a design note first
options.body: Keep the tracker open but ask for a short maintainer design on access control, persistence, outbound authority, and upgrade behavior before accepting another PR.

options.title: Defer Business support
options.body: Keep relay/proxy workarounds outside core until maintainers approve a plugin/API direction for Telegram Business personal-DM access.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded bundled support
recommendation.body: Implement this in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc both closed the prior implementation pending Telegram-owner direction and has recent current-main history on the Telegram seams this feature must touch.
